title: Apprentice Talent Acquisition Coordinator
description:
Full-Time - Monday-Friday - Hybrid - L3 apprenticeship in Recruitment (18 months)

Salary: £25,311 per annum

Looking to start your career in Recruitment and Talent Acquisition?

Are you organised, confident communicating with people, and eager to learn? Do you enjoy building relationships and want to develop a career in recruitment while gaining a nationally recognised qualification?

If so, why not start your recruitment journey with Staffline?

Apprentice Talent Acquisition Coordinator

This is a hybrid role, splitting your time between working from home and our Nottingham office.

As an Apprentice Talent Acquisition Coordinator, you'll join our Talent Acquisition team while completing a Level 3 Recruitment Apprenticeship over 18 months. You'll gain hands-on experience supporting recruitment activities across a variety of roles while developing the skills and knowledge needed for a successful career in Talent Acquisition.

Working closely with the Talent Acquisition team, hiring managers and candidates, you'll help deliver a positive and efficient recruitment experience from attraction through to onboarding.

What you'll do as an Apprentice Talent Acquisition Coordinator

This is a fantastic opportunity to learn from experienced recruitment professionals and develop your career with the UK's largest recruiter.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Supporting the Talent Acquisition team with recruitment activity across a range of vacancies.
- Advertising vacancies across job boards, social media channels and other attraction platforms.
- Sourcing potential candidates and building talent pipelines.
- Screening applications and carrying out initial candidate conversations.
- Coordinating interviews and maintaining communication with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
- Supporting hiring managers with recruitment administration and scheduling.
- Maintaining accurate candidate records within recruitment systems.
- Providing regular updates to candidates and stakeholders to ensure a positive recruitment experience.
- Supporting recruitment projects, employer branding initiatives and talent attraction campaigns.
- Completing your Level 3 Recruitment Resourcer Apprenticeship and applying your learning within the workplace.

What you'll need to succeed

We're looking for someone with enthusiasm, curiosity and a genuine interest in developing a career in recruitment.

You'll ideally have:
- A strong interest in recruitment, Talent Acquisition or Human Resources.
- Excellent communication skills and confidence speaking with a range of people.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks.
- Good attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate records.
- A positive attitude and willingness to learn.
- The ability to build relationships and work collaboratively with colleagues and stakeholders.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office applications.
- The ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
- GCSEs (or equivalent) in English and Maths would be advantageous.

What you'll gain
- A Level 3 Recruitment Apprenticeship qualification.
- Hands-on experience within an in-house Talent Acquisition team.
- Ongoing support and mentoring from experienced recruitment professionals.
- Opportunities to develop your recruitment, sourcing and stakeholder management skills.
- A strong foundation for a long-term career in Talent Acquisition and HR.

Why join us?

This role offers the opportunity to develop your recruitment career within a supportive Talent Acquisition team, working across a variety of business areas while gaining valuable in-house recruitment experience.

Like the sound of this? Apply now, or get in touch with the Talent Acquisition team for further information.

title: HR & Payroll Coordinator
description:
People Services & Payroll Coordinator
Nottingham Full-Time Permanent
Hybrid & Flexible working

Are you an experienced HR or People Administrator with payroll experience looking for your next opportunity?

We're recruiting on behalf of a growing business looking to add a HR & Payroll Coordinator to its People team. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys providing an excellent employee experience while supporting both HR administration and the monthly payroll process.

The Role

Working closely with the People Services Manager, you'll play a key role in supporting the employee lifecycle while coordinating accurate payroll administration.

Key responsibilities include:

-Supporting the full employee lifecycle, including starters, leavers and contractual changes.
-Acting as the first point of contact for HR and payroll queries.
-Coordinating the monthly UK payroll process.
-Preparing payroll data, including overtime, bonuses and deductions.
-Liaising with the external payroll provider to ensure accurate processing.
-Maintaining HR systems and employee records.
-Supporting employee benefits administration.
-Assisting with payroll audits, pensions and year-end activities.
-Supporting HR projects and continuous improvement initiatives.

About You

We're looking for someone who has:

Previous experience within HR Administration, People Services or Payroll.
Experience supporting or coordinating a monthly UK payroll.
Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
Strong communication and customer service skills.
A proactive approach with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
Knowledge of UK payroll processes and employment legislation would be advantageous.

If you're looking for a varied role where you'll play an important part in supporting both colleagues and payroll processes, we'd love to hear from you.

title: HR Administrator
description:
Role: HR Administrator
Location: Mansfield
Salary: Negotiable dept on exp

We're on the lookout for a switched-on, detail-driven HR Administrator to join our busy HR function. If you enjoy variety, keep a cool head when things get hectic, and genuinely care about giving employees a great experience, this could be a great fit.

You'll be involved across the whole employee journey -from the moment someone applies, through their first days on the job, right up to handling more sensitive HR matters and supporting broader people initiatives. You'll work hand-in-hand with line managers and staff throughout the business to keep HR processes running smoothly, staying compliant and people-first at every step.

The role of HR Administrator will involve:
- Helping run recruitment activity and making sure candidates have a smooth, positive journey from application to job offer
- Organising pre-start paperwork, onboarding schedules and induction plans for new joiners
- Carrying out right-to-work verification and other compliance checks
- Keeping HR systems and employee files accurate and up to date
- Drafting HR paperwork such as letters, records and meeting summaries
- Providing admin support during disciplinary meetings, grievance hearings and investigations, including note-taking and filing
- Helping refine and improve HR policies and workflows over time
- Getting involved in broader HR team projects as they come up
- Making sure everything you do stays aligned with UK employment law and internal policy
- Acting as a helpful, reliable point of contact for managers and staff with HR queries

You're a personable, well-organised HR professional who takes real pride in doing things properly and building good working relationships. Ideally, you'll bring:
- Some background in an HR admin, coordinator or generalist capacity
- CIPD qualification (or working towards one)
- A solid grasp of HR practices and UK employment law
- Great people skills - you communicate clearly and build trust easily
- A methodical, well-structured way of working
- Sharp attention to detail and strong admin capability
- Comfort juggling several priorities while hitting deadlines
- Good judgement and a practical approach to solving problems
- A track record of handling confidential information responsibly

Interested? Email your CV or Call TurnerFox for more information
